_comment: REDACTED SAMPLE — see evidence/README.md. Real IPs, hostnames and the manager name are replaced with placeholders. Wazuh writes alerts.json as newline-delimited JSON; this file is a pretty-printed array for readability.
_note: 1/4 — the correlated brute-force detection. frequency=3 satisfied, so rule 100100 fires once for three underlying 5760 failures. previous_output carries the two prior failures that completed the window.

_note: 2/4 — enforcement. Alert 651 follows ~2s after 100100: the manager dispatched firewall-drop to the agent, which added the iptables DROP. This 2s gap is exactly why active response alone is insufficient and pam_faillock is layered alongside it.

rule.description: Host Blocked by firewall-drop Active Response
